sections.content: All listed sources have complete single-page coverage. Summaries are bounded and redacted while preserving source status and key behavioral constraints.
sections.title: Coverage

sections.content: The materials define strict typed skill-input gates, deterministic transport and coverage checks, non-authorizing lifecycle evidence, plan-local validation, TDD progression, immutable receipts, and fail-closed handling for drift or missing inputs.
sections.title: Execution Guidance

sections.content: Repository guidance requires scoped changes, protected-path care, explicit authority ownership, validated evidence, and targeted verification. ADRs govern knowledge selection, publication, recovery, retention, and acceptance evidence.
